headlines.name: This supernova is 50 million light-years away, but that's close enough for astronomers
headlines.headline: This supernova is 50 million light-years away, but that's close enough for astronomers
headlines.description: A new supernova has been spotted in NGC 1433, a spiral galaxy about 50 million light-years away. That's pretty close for supernova observations, and it's an opportunity for detailed follow-up study. It's not a core-collapse supernova, in which a massive star burns through its fuel, collapses and explodes. It's a Type Ia supernova.
